author.name: Mao Zedong
author.heading: About Mao Zedong
author.bio: Mao Zedong led the Chinese Communist Party to victory in the civil war and helped establish the People’s Republic of China in 1949. His later campaigns included the Great Leap Forward and the Cultural Revolution; the use of his name as a quotation authority needs to be distinguished from a source in his actual writings.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Mao’s language about chaos reflected a revolutionary approach in which upheaval could be treated as politically productive. The ANU discussion contrasts that rhetoric with later emphases on control, but the broad historical fit cannot replace a source for the particular “situation is excellent” formulation.
